name: Sakaiminato (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakaiminato city emblem in blue: a stylised bird-like swirl with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Sakaiminato, a city in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 April 1956.

features.role: Sakaiminato city emblem — a stylised bird-like swirl with a pointed top
